name: Flixor---Backend
description: A fast, Netflix‑style web app, Android, iOS, and MacOS for your Plex library. Browse beautiful rows, see rich details (IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes), and play instantly in your browser with built‑in DASH/HLS playback. Works on any modern desktop or mobile browser. This is the backend component.

variables.name: Frontend URL
variables.description: The URL where the frontend is hosted (e.g., http://localhost:8080). Required if using the frontend app.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: A long, random string used to sign session cookies.

variables.name: Internal API Port
variables.description: Internal API port. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Host
variables.description: Internal host. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Config Path
variables.description: Internal path to the config files. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Database Path
variables.description: Internal path to the database file. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Image Cache Path
variables.description: Internal path to the image cache. Not recommended to change.
